page.overview:
Who is Teeth Devil?

The の|Ha no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of teeth.

The Teeth Devil's full appearance is unknown, though its miniature effigy created by the Death Devil that Denji temporarily consumed suggests the Teeth Devil to have an elongated body and a pair of tusks, similar to that of a walrus along with what seems to be a tail at its back and no visible legs. However, the lack of legs may not be the Teeth Devil's natural state, as the Legs Devil had been erased at the time.

The Teeth Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At an unknown point in time, the Death Devil was able to subdue the Teeth Devil and turn it into one of her pawns.
